name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

actionName.description: Name of the action which this vertex represents

args.description:
Map from argument name to value for all arguments which are not {@link Data}, {@link Data.Series}, or another
{@link Data}-related type such as {@link Data.GroupBy} - those arguments will be represented by named ports and
inputs to this vertex

callingType.description: The calling type of the action represented by this vertex.

returnType.description:
The return type of the action represented by this vertex. Will always be one of {@link Data}, {@link Data.Series},
or another {@link Data}-related type such as {@link Data.GroupBy}

cache.description:
Optional field which holds cached Data, if {@link DataImpl.Lazy} from which this vertex was created was cached.
Used to avoid re-materializing Data once we have converted Data to Data.Flow representation.

title:
Vertex in an {@link Data.Flow} which represents an action that returns a {@link Data}, {@link Data.Series}, or
another {@link Data}-related type such as {@link Data.GroupBy}
name: Data.Flow.Action
